content.zekr_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ.
content.zekr_english: All praise is for Allah Who gave us life after He had caused us to die (sleep) and to Him is the resurrection.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa ilayhin-nushoor.
content.bless_arabic: تذكير بالبعث وشكر لله على نعمة الحياة بعد الموت الصغير (النوم).
content.bless_english: A reminder of resurrection and gratitude to Allah for the blessing of life after the minor death (sleep).

content.zekr_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ. رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي.
content.zekr_english: There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partners. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things competent. Glory be to Allah, and all praise is for Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest, and there is no might nor power except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great. My Lord, forgive me.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Subhaanallaahi, walhamdu lillaahi, wa laa ilaaha illallaahu, wallaahu Akbar, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil-'Aliyyil-'Adheem. Rabbi ighfir lee.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها غفرت له ذنوبه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر.
content.bless_english: Whoever says it, his sins will be forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
content.source: Sunan Ibn Majah 2/335, graded Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Ibn Majah 2/354.

content.zekr_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَعَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ.
content.zekr_english: All praise is for Allah Who returned my soul to me, and gave me well-being in my body, and permitted me to remember Him.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee radda 'alayya roohee wa 'aafaanee fee jasadee wa adhina lee bidhikrih.
content.bless_arabic: شكر الله على نعمة اليقظة والعافية والقدرة على ذكره.
content.bless_english: Gratitude to Allah for the blessing of waking up, health, and the ability to remember Him.
content.source: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/473, graded Hasan by Al-Albani.
